o: Follows Ben DeSoto, a hospice caretaker suffering from triskaidekaphobia, who takes a strange job at The Apollyon, an eerie residential building inhabited by characters from seasons past.

eps.o: After a near-death experience, Ben provides hospice care for a mysterious client in an eerie penthouse.
Ben struggles with some unusual hospice duties and learns how the job vacancy actually happened.
While hosting a holiday party, Constance deals carefully with two surprise guests, all to keep the special night on course.
As Constance's evening winds down, the holiday guests have dark places to go and people to see.
A friend of Ben's girlfriend wants to reconnect, whether he is ready to face the past or not.
As an unseen threat closes in, the witches of Miss Robichaux's Academy turn to forgotten magic.

eps.t: The Baddest Witch of Them All
eps.o: A home invasion like no other, and Cordelia's Coven finds its worst fears confirmed.
With an ungodly threat upon them, the witches strike a bargain that will cost someone dearly.

eps.t: The Devil Is in the Details
eps.o: Alone and at a loss, Constance risks everything to reinvent her family's fate.
Under threat, the witches learn of an ancient evil that has shaped history's darkest hours.
When a charming stranger draws close to the Coven, Madison discovers an unexpected side to him.
Fiona confronts a family secret, while the Coven prepares for a foe worse than any they've faced.
Cordelia's witches try their hardest to come together as their chances to save the world grow dim.
